_meta.description: Project-level Internal KI. Cross-session learnings, decisions, and patterns.

recordingPolicy.decisions: 每次 plan 关闭或重大技术选择时，必须记录 1-2 条 decision
recordingPolicy.lessons: 每次 QA 通过或返工修复后，必须评估是否有可沉淀经验
recordingPolicy.patterns: 当某个操作方式/架构模式被证明在项目内高频复用时，沉淀为 pattern

decisions.rationale: Optimized for ≤7500 token per-load budget. quickLookup enables O(1) routing.

decisions.decision: Automated 20-signal structural audit via PowerShell script
decisions.rationale: Initial intuition-based scoring was systematically biased +0.28 avg. Automated audit is reproducible.
decisions.outcome: All 92 scores corrected downward. 0 Excellent, 10 Good, 39 Fair.

decisions.rationale: Aligns with industry consensus (Anthropic orchestrator-workers, LangGraph layered state, MemGPT tiered memory). Provides clearer separation of concerns. Supported by OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, CrewAI patterns.
decisions.outcome: Migration completed. Old AI/ and external_KI/ retained as backup.

decisions.decision: Upgrade execution.md from v1 (serial-only) to v2 (serial/parallel/swarm)
decisions.rationale: v1 serial-only was a known limitation. task_dag.schema already supported dependencies field for parallel. Industry frameworks (Google ADK ParallelAgent, Anthropic Sectioning, CrewAI) all support multi-mode.

lessons.lesson: File size is NOT a reliable proxy for quality. A 25KB file can be mostly boilerplate while a 10KB file can be dense and actionable.
lessons.evidence: agentic-engineering: 63 lines but initially scored 0.82. Writing-skills: 655 lines legitimately scored 0.85.
lessons.prevention: Always use multi-signal structural audit, not single-dimension proxy.

lessons.lesson: Background agents may fail due to tool permissions. Always verify agent output and have fallback to main process execution.
lessons.evidence: 3 of 4 layer-creation agents failed due to bash permission denial. Main process had to complete their work.
lessons.prevention: For critical file operations, prefer main process execution or verify agent results immediately.
